scope_note: These three counts are NOT the same measurement and must not be compared pairwise. git_grep_files is `git grep --untracked -l -E --ignore-case -e function`, i.e. case-insensitive files-with-matches. rg_files_hidden_gitignore is `rg --hidden -l` with the VCS globs and no -i, i.e. case-sensitive; that is why it reads 90 files below git grep. The same-configuration rg value recorded in bench-grep-results.json is 7228 under -i, leaving a 9-file delta against git grep that this PR does not reconcile. system_grep_files counts files MATCHING under the pre-fix recursive argv, not files walked; the walked count is files_searched on each result row, so reading 78624 against 165575 as a scan ratio is wrong.
samples_note: No per-sample arrays were retained for this run: min_ms == median_ms == max_ms on every row, so these three figures are single runs, not medians of five. bench-grep-results.json's provenance originally claimed this file retained full samples; it does not.
comparison_note: Historical single-run values only. The original harness and exact tree state were not retained sufficiently to reconcile the 165575 reads with the later independent 37071-entry enumeration. The before/after JS ratios are not a controlled speedup measurement; do not infer reduced enumeration from them.
